description: UI foundation: brand/semantic tokens, theme, brand slot, icons, primitives, thresholds module, domain modules (agents, why), API client additions, lint/format scripts, shell + scenario launcher + form + recents restyle, useCheckoutRun hook. assets/brand/README.md, brand/logo.ts (import.meta.glob logo.{svg,png}), BrandMark with optional logoUrl prop; text wordmark ACIP + 'Global Payments' co-brand fallback

All brand colours exist only in brand.css

git diff --stat ui/package-lock.json shows no change
findings: Done. Lint, format:check, typecheck, test (79 pass), build all green; package-lock.json unchanged. Notes for later steps: (1) typecheck script is `tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit` because `tsc -b --noEmit` errors (TS6310, composite tsconfig.node.json). (2) .prettierignore added (dist, package-lock.json, tsbuildinfo, vite.config.js/.d.ts). (3) Components were moved: CheckoutForm/RecentTransactions now in components/input/; ScenarioButtons and styles.css deleted. Old DecisionBanner, AgentCards, ExplainView remain unchanged (old tests still pass) and are composed in App.tsx; FEAT-003 replaces them. Their CSS classes (.decision-banner, .agent-card, .explain-*) are styled in components.css and can be removed then. (4) why() (domain/why.ts) takes {decision, explanation, compositeScore, route, routeAlternatives, verdicts} and is NOT yet rendered anywhere. AGENTS/agentInfo in domain/agents.ts; TOOLTIPS in content/tooltips.ts (stages/help/glossary/tour content modules not created yet). (5) useCheckoutRun (state/useCheckoutRun.ts) exposes {state, runCheckout(req,label,key?), selectRecent, loadExplain, setReplayIndex}; phases per plan 6; state has request, response, transaction, explain, roundTripMs, replayIndex, notFound, loadingHistory, recent, lastByKey, runningKey. No replay timer yet (FEAT-003). Header has no Tour/Help buttons yet (FEAT-004); EmptyState takes optional onStartTour/onOpenHelp. (6) UI primitives: Icon (IconName type), InfoTip(term,text), StatusBadge(decision,prefix), ScoreBar(label,value,tick), CopyButton(text,what), Disclosure(title). ThemeProvider wraps App in main.tsx; ThemeContext has a safe default so tests need no provider. (7) vitest.setup.ts presets acip.tour.done=1 and stubs matchMedia/scrollIntoView each test. InfoTip click opens only (hover/focus already open it), Esc/blur close.
